@graph.comment: IdCatalogStore (D111 §4.4) — server-derived identifier-scheme catalog. Inserted BETWEEN Locking and Patching so N3 Patches are inspected as TEXT before application (the derived-subject 409 guard), and record writes are read after they land to derive the thin catalog entry in-band. Resolved chain (top→bottom): Monitoring → BinarySlice → Index → Locking → IdCatalogStore → Patching → AdmissionFloor → Shape → Converting → backend. Below Patching means the store sees both N3 Patch (modifyResource) and resolved-representation writes (set/add/delete); above Patching the floor + shape validation still gate record bodies (records under /id/schemes/ pass through this store untouched to the floor below).

Re-state LockingResourceStore's FULL parameter set (overrideParameters REPLACES, not merges — like solid-config.json's Patching override): @type + locks + auxiliaryStrategy copied verbatim from the upstream default (config/storage/middleware/stores/locking.json), with source swapped from ResourceStore_Patching to our IdCatalogStore.

The IdCatalogStore itself. source → ResourceStore_Patching (the link Locking used to hold, restored here so the chain re-closes below us). catalogUrl is the /id/schemes/ container URL (trailing slash REQUIRED — the constructor asserts it; the store appends '.meta' to derive /id/schemes/.meta). Lives OUTSIDE the /vault storage root (D111: rename-proof datatype IRIs). A record write under the catalog → pass through to source, then derive the thin entry + rewrite the catalog .meta below Locking (kept-quads preserves CSS-managed dcat:Catalog typing + ldp:constrainedBy + dct:title; ldp:contains is regenerated by the backend). A client write touching the container / its .meta / a #fragment subject → 409 (server-derived; write the record, not the index — the ldp:contains precedent).
